entries.source:
DAY NIGHT
#
DRV SAGHO
OAB FIRMT
FLC HRUNI
EPY NGHSK
#
The light one breaks but never falls.
His brother falls but never breaks.�
entries.translation:
DAY NIGHT
#
DRV SAGHO
OAB FIRMT
FLC HRUNI
EPY NGHSK
#
明亮的那位只會破曉，從不跌落。
他的兄弟只會降臨，從不破曉。�

entries.source:
HANGMAN
#
WORGSEL
HBNBMSE
SHINETN
AAEOTAR
#
Swollag, the famous moredhel
craftsman, guarantees his work
until the end of time.�
entries.translation:
HANGMAN
#
WORGSEL
HBNBMSE
SHINETN
AAEOTAR
#
斯沃拉格，那位聲名遠播的莫瑞德人工匠，
為自己的作品掛保證，
直到時間盡頭都不會壞。�

entries.source:
FIRE
#
WSTE
AINL
FORN
BREH
#
The chill of its death,
You may soon mourn.
But though it dies,
It cannot be born.�
entries.translation:
FIRE
#
WSTE
AINL
FORN
BREH
#
它死去時的寒意，
你很快就會哀悼。
但即使它死了，
卻從未真正誕生過。�

entries.source:
RAIN
#
RSOE
SERN
ENAT
LAIO
#
You see it about in field and town,
It cannot get up,
But will oft fall down.�
entries.translation:
RAIN
#
RSOE
SERN
ENAT
LAIO
#
你在田野與城鎮四處可見，
它永遠爬不起來，
卻常常落下。�

entries.source:
THE DEAD
#
SHT WESD
OBS DAET
LEE RIAS
TRN ORTO
#
They feel no pain,
No sorrow, no greed.
They have no anger,
No hatred, nor need.�
entries.translation:
THE DEAD
#
SHT WESD
OBS DAET
LEE RIAS
TRN ORTO
#
他們感受不到痛苦，
沒有悲傷，沒有貪婪。
他們沒有憤怒，
沒有仇恨，也沒有需求。�

entries.source:
SMOKE
#
RMEES
SHPKT
TERLR
ALOBE
#
Though easy to spot,
when allowed to plume,
It is hard to see,
When held in a room.�
entries.translation:
SMOKE
#
RMEES
SHPKT
TERLR
ALOBE
#
雖然容易發現，
只要任它裊裊升起，
卻難以看清，
一旦困在房間裡。�

entries.source:
EYES
#
AHAE
TAET
SYIS
ELNN
#
Be you ever so quick,
With vision keen,
By your eyes,
We are never seen.
Unless, perchance,
It should come to pass,
You see our reflection,
In a looking glass.�
entries.translation:
EYES
#
AHAE
TAET
SYIS
ELNN
#
任憑你眼明手快，
視力再怎麼銳利，
用你的雙眼，
也永遠看不見我們。
除非，偶然間，
恰好碰上這種情況，
你看見我們的倒影，
映在一面鏡子裡。�

entries.source:
RING
#
ROBN
OLEG
SHIE
TINS
#
A precious gift, this,
Yet it has no end or beginning,
And in the middle, nothing.�
entries.translation:
RING
#
ROBN
OLEG
SHIE
TINS
#
這是件珍貴的禮物，
卻沒有起點，也沒有終點，
正中央，什麼也沒有。�

entries.source:
SHADOW
#
RHNBFT
SLEDNW
AEATOL
NILORK
#
Silently he stalks me,
Running as I run,
Creeping as I creep.
Dressed in black,
He disappears at night,
Only to return with the sun.�
entries.translation:
SHADOW
#
RHNBFT
SLEDNW
AEATOL
NILORK
#
他悄悄地跟蹤著我，
我跑他也跑，
我爬他也爬。
一身黑衣，
入夜便消失無蹤，
唯有隨著日出才會回來。�

entries.source:
GLOVES
#
SHORAS
TLLDTR
GREESH
AERVEE
#
Buckets, barrels, baskets, cans;
What must you fill with empty hands?�
entries.translation:
GLOVES
#
SHORAS
TLLDTR
GREESH
AERVEE
#
水桶、木桶、籃子、罐子；
什麼東西必須用空手去填滿？�

entries.source:
ARROW
#
PSAOS
LRWTW
ETRHE
AOSET
#
It flies without wings,
Strikes without beak, teeth,
or talons. It has no eyes
in its pointed head,
but it can kill birds in flight.�
entries.translation:
ARROW
#
PSAOS
LRWTW
ETRHE
AOSET
#
它沒有翅膀，卻能飛翔，
不用喙、不用牙齒，
也不用爪子出擊。它尖尖的頭上
沒有眼睛，
卻能在空中射殺飛鳥。�

entries.source:
STAIRS
#
TERIES
RHARRE
STESTT
ALLOND
#
Up and down they go,
but never move...�
entries.translation:
STAIRS
#
TERIES
RHARRE
STESTT
ALLOND
#
它們上上下下，
卻從不移動……�

entries.source:
CANDLE
#
RHEDLS
STNBET
TARLAO
CIGORE
#
He gets short when he gets old.
He goes out then it gets cold.�
entries.translation:
CANDLE
#
RHEDLS
STNBET
TARLAO
CIGORE
#
他越老就變得越短，
他熄滅後便轉為冰冷。�

entries.source:
WIND
#
PATD
NIDE
AHNS
WOSH
#
The strongest chains will not bind it,
ditch and rampart will not slow it down.
A thousand soldiers cannot beat it,
it can knock down trees with a single push.�
entries.translation:
WIND
#
PATD
NIDE
AHNS
WOSH
#
再堅固的鎖鏈也困不住它，
壕溝與城牆也擋不住它的腳步。
千軍萬馬也打不贏它，
它輕輕一推，就能把樹木撂倒。�

entries.source:
BLOOD
#
TROPS
BHEDT
CERRD
OLAOA
#
Moredhel brothers, make it rain,
Kingdom rivers, crimson pain!�
entries.translation:
BLOOD
#
TROPS
BHEDT
CERRD
OLAOA
#
莫瑞德人的兄弟們，讓它如雨落下，
王國的河流，染成猩紅的痛楚！�

entries.source:
RIVER
#
MORIT
WHATS
AIVSR
RRIEE
#
An untiring servant it is,
carrying loads across muddy earth.
But one thing that cannot be forced,
is a return to the place of its birth.�
entries.translation:
RIVER
#
MORIT
WHATS
AIVSR
RRIEE
#
它是個不知疲倦的僕役，
馱著重擔穿越泥濘大地。
但有一件事誰也強求不了，
那就是回到它出生的地方。�

entries.source:
SWORD
#
SOOES
JHDRI
EUEST
MWNGD
#
With sharp edged wit,
And pointed poise,
It can settle disputes,
Without a noise.�
entries.translation:
SWORD
#
SOOES
JHDRI
EUEST
MWNGD
#
憑著鋒利的機智，
與尖銳的氣度，
它能了結爭端，
無聲無息。�

entries.source:
ICE
#
THR
SCO
IET
WSE
#
Power enough to smash ships
and crush roofs. Yet it still
must fear the sun.�
entries.translation:
ICE
#
THR
SCO
IET
WSE
#
它的力量足以擊碎船隻、
壓垮屋頂。然而它
仍然畏懼陽光。�

entries.source:
ALCOHOL
#
AROOLET
TLIHHVS
BOCROOL
FAEETRE
#
Today he is there to trip you up,
And he will torture you tomorrow.
Yet he is also there to ease the pain,
When you are lost in grief and sorrow.�
entries.translation:
ALCOHOL
#
AROOLET
TLIHHVS
BOCROOL
FAEETRE
#
今日他在那裡絆你一跤，
明日他便折磨你不休。
然而他也在那裡緩解痛苦，
當你深陷悲傷與哀愁之時。�

entries.source:
DELEKHAN
#
BREETOEW
FLRUSNVN
DOLTRHPR
AEKOKDAM
#
Death to our Enemies!
no Living adversary shall
Escape the new King of
these isles. He will lead us
to glory And provide New
lands for our people!�
entries.translation:
DELEKHAN
#
BREETOEW
FLRUSNVN
DOLTRHPR
AEKOKDAM
#
消滅我們的敵人！
沒有一個生還的敵手，
能逃過這些島嶼的
新王之手。他將帶領我們
邁向榮耀，並為我們的子民
開闢新的疆土！�

entries.source:
TREASURE
#
TAALREWL
PREHOUPB
OHDASWLE
SLSEITRX
#
Moredhel And Pantathian,
Guarding Our Lid, Did
Close Her Ever So Tightly.�
entries.translation:
TREASURE
#
TAALREWL
PREHOUPB
OHDASWLE
SLSEITRX
#
莫瑞德人與潘塔西亞人，
守護著我們的蓋子，
將她封得密不透風。�

entries.source:
HOLE
#
RTLE
SOES
ERRL
HAVT
#
It can hold you,
But you cannot hold it.
And the more you remove,
The bigger it will get.�
entries.translation:
HOLE
#
RTLE
SOES
ERRL
HAVT
#
它能困住你，
但你卻困不住它。
你挖走的越多，
它就會變得越大。�

entries.source:
RUST
#
TULD
RSOE
HESS
ADVT
#
It can pierce the best armor,
And make swords crumble with a rub.
Yet for all its power,
It can't harm a club.�
entries.translation:
RUST
#
TULD
RSOE
HESS
ADVT
#
它能刺穿最堅固的鎧甲，
只消一磨就能讓劍崩碎。
然而縱有這般威力，
它卻傷不了一根棍棒。�

entries.source:
VICTORY
#
SHOTEED
TICOSIT
ARESOTY
VARITRS
#
With this one thing alone,
you will have defeated
even the strongest foe.�
entries.translation:
VICTORY
#
SHOTEED
TICOSIT
ARESOTY
VARITRS
#
光憑這一樣東西，
你就能擊敗
即使是最強大的敵人。�

entries.source:
EYE TO EYE
#
RAE IN SOL
BRS OO TYA
EOI TE LIQ
SYN AS EDE
#
Three fools did once sacrifice,
To win a contest long ago.
Dobe Oyle, a Kingdom lad,
gave his blood to start.
A goblin man, Ethorat,
hacked out his dying heart.
Sou Oyle, Dobe's sister, won,
she cast away her soul.�
entries.translation:
EYE TO EYE
#
RAE IN SOL
BRS OO TYA
EOI TE LIQ
SYN AS EDE
#
曾經有三個傻子獻祭，
只為贏得一場古老的較量。
多貝奧爾，一位王國少年，
獻出鮮血作為開端。
一個哥布林男子，伊索拉特，
挖出了他垂死的心臟。
蘇奧爾，多貝的姊妹，贏了，
她拋棄了自己的靈魂。�

entries.source:
THORN
#
SHSTE
CLIRD
ARAUN
TEOGS
#
He got it in the woods and
brought it home in his hand
because he couldn't find it.
The more he looked for it the
more he felt it. When he finally
found it he threw it away.�
entries.translation:
THORN
#
SHSTE
CLIRD
ARAUN
TEOGS
#
他在林子裡染上了它，
帶著它一路走回家，
因為他一直找不到它。
他越是尋找，
就越能感覺到它。等他終於
找到了它，卻把它扔了。�

entries.source:
HOLES
#
WEMHI
GOPTD
HRLEF
NHIOS
#
A barrel of rainwater
weighs twenty pounds.
What must you add
to make it weigh fifteen?�
entries.translation:
HOLES
#
WEMHI
GOPTD
HRLEF
NHIOS
#
一桶雨水
重達二十磅。
你必須加入什麼，
才能讓它只剩十五磅重？�

entries.source:
HAIR
#
TRKY
EAIE
HLLD
BEER
#
Kingdom fools are born without,
A lot of this, there is no doubt.�
entries.translation:
HAIR
#
TRKY
EAIE
HLLD
BEER
#
王國的傻子生來就缺少，
這東西，確實少了不少。�

entries.source:
EGGS
#
EITL
TOEE
RGLS
SNGD
#
They go up white,
but come down yellow and white.�
entries.translation:
EGGS
#
EITL
TOEE
RGLS
SNGD
#
它們升起時是白色的，
落下時卻是黃白相間。�

entries.source:
NOTHING
#
SOSLPLG
PLTHNEK
EHCOINS
NEIEKSE
#
We love it more than life.
We fear it more than death.
The wealthy want for it.
The poor have it in plenty.�
entries.translation:
NOTHING
#
SOSLPLG
PLTHNEK
EHCOINS
NEIEKSE
#
我們愛它勝過生命。
我們怕它勝過死亡。
富人渴望擁有它。
窮人卻擁有得太多。�

entries.source:
KNOCKER
#
KLICBTR
TERTOIE
AIDECES
INOLKST
#
It asks no questions,
but demands many answers.
Don't knock it until you
are ready to see what waits
on the other side.�
entries.translation:
KNOCKER
#
KLICBTR
TERTOIE
AIDECES
INOLKST
#
它從不發問，
卻要求許多答案。
別去敲它，除非你
已經準備好看清
門的另一邊等著什麼。�

entries.source:
CHEST
#
SASSU
TLILT
CREOS
AHRIE
#
MAGIC
DEATH
TEMPLE
BLESS
REST
At last you may solve this.�
entries.translation:
CHEST
#
SASSU
TLILT
CREOS
AHRIE
#
魔法
死亡
神殿
祝福
安息
你終於能解開這個謎題了。�

entries.source:
MILK
#
SOSK
MRLS
ATOT
DIDE
#
You can spin, wheel and twist.
But it can turn without moving.�
entries.translation:
MILK
#
SOSK
MRLS
ATOT
DIDE
#
你可以旋轉、繞圈、扭動，
但它不必移動也能變化。�

entries.source:
BARD
#
BSRO
AOTT
RASN
FRUD
#
Who works when he plays,
and plays when he works?�
entries.translation:
BARD
#
BSRO
AOTT
RASN
FRUD
#
誰在玩樂時工作，
又在工作時玩樂？�

entries.source:
DIE
#
DOC
ARE
FEW
SIN
#
Prince Arutha, from his lofty perch,
Will find our troops without a search.
His men will fall, his castle too,
And then what will Prince Arutha do?�
entries.translation:
DIE
#
DOC
ARE
FEW
SIN
#
亞魯莎親王站在他的高處，
不必搜尋就能發現我們的軍隊。
他的部下會倒下，他的城堡也是，
到那時，亞魯莎親王又能怎麼辦？�

entries.source:
SILENCE
#
TUVETED
RPINNCE
SHOOYSS
OILSRRY
#
Names give power.
Magic to control.
But what is broken,
by naming it?�
entries.translation:
SILENCE
#
TUVETED
RPINNCE
SHOOYSS
OILSRRY
#
名字賦予力量，
賦予掌控的魔法。
但有什麼東西，
一旦被說出名字就會破碎？�

entries.source:
WRONG
#
PERDE
WOISD
THONS
IREOG
#
The language of men,
can be mastered.
But what Kingdom word
is always pronounced wrong?�
entries.translation:
WRONG
#
PERDE
WOISD
THONS
IREOG
#
人類的語言，
是能夠學會的。
但有哪個王國的字，
永遠被念錯？�

entries.source:
CARDS
#
SLLAT
CARSD
ATIRS
OUSDE
#
Brought to the table.
Cut and served.
Never eaten.�
entries.translation:
CARDS
#
SLLAT
CARSD
ATIRS
OUSDE
#
被端上了桌，
被切開、分發，
卻從未被吃下。�

entries.source:
PEACE
#
SIADE
THOCT
PRTLS
AESIY
#
Widows and orphans,
Parents and kin.
This is disturbed most
by riots and war.�
entries.translation:
PEACE
#
SIADE
THOCT
PRTLS
AESIY
#
寡婦與孤兒，
父母與親族。
最常打破這一切的，
就是暴亂與戰爭。�

entries.source:
SHADOW
#
THTATW
SRAUUY
WEILSS
AOVDOE
#
It can move over water,
But cannot fly.
It can move under water,
But stay quite dry.�
entries.translation:
SHADOW
#
THTATW
SRAUUY
WEILSS
AOVDOE
#
它能在水面上移動，
卻不會飛翔。
它能在水底下移動，
卻始終保持乾燥。�

entries.source:
WAGON
#
RARPE
WHGMD
EITEB
SLCON
#
Has tongue,
But cannot talk.
Runs,
But cannot walk.�
entries.translation:
WAGON
#
RARPE
WHGMD
EITEB
SLCON
#
它有舌頭，
卻不能說話。
它會跑，
卻不會走路。�

entries.source:
SAWS
#
TIWE
SREY
WHIT
OADS
#
We don't need wine,
We don't need meat.
We have sharp teeth,
But cannot eat.�
entries.translation:
SAWS
#
TIWE
SREY
WHIT
OADS
#
我們不需要美酒，
我們不需要肉食。
我們擁有鋒利的牙齒，
卻無法進食。�

entries.source:
TABLE
#
CLAYS
SATRE
IHBID
TOELO
#
It stands while others sit.
It groans when it is too full.
It has four legs, but cannot run.�
entries.translation:
TABLE
#
CLAYS
SATRE
IHBID
TOELO
#
別人坐著時，它站著。
它裝得太滿就會呻吟。
它有四條腿，卻不會跑。�

entries.source:
WALL
#
SAMT
WILS
PROL
ETUE
#
It goes past gates,
but asks no one's leave.
It runs clear around castles,
without taking a step.�
entries.translation:
WALL
#
SAMT
WILS
PROL
ETUE
#
它越過城門，
卻不必徵求誰的同意。
它繞著城堡一路延伸，
卻連一步也沒邁出。�

entries.source:
SUNSHINE
#
TUORBCTN
ARNNEIAE
SOLOTENT
MHTSHYKS
#
Never resting, never still.
Moving silently, hill to hill.
It does not walk, run or trot,
All is cool where it is not.�
entries.translation:
SUNSHINE
#
TUORBCTN
ARNNEIAE
SOLOTENT
MHTSHYKS
#
它從不歇息，從不靜止。
悄悄地，從一座山移向另一座山。
它不走、不跑、也不小跑，
沒有它的地方，一片清涼。�

entries.source:
NAME
#
TRSE
PENS
MAMY
NIOT
#
Passed from father to son,
And shared between brothers.
Its importance is unquestioned,
Though it is used more by others.�
entries.translation:
NAME
#
TRSE
PENS
MAMY
NIOT
#
從父親傳給兒子，
在兄弟之間共享。
它的重要無庸置疑，
卻更常被別人使用。�

entries.source:
NOISE
#
BESTD
SLESE
NRILT
FOTOY
#
What goes with a wagon that
doesn't benefit the wagon,
but the wagon cannot move without?�
entries.translation:
NOISE
#
BESTD
SLESE
NRILT
FOTOY
#
什麼東西總跟著馬車，
對馬車本身毫無益處，
但少了它馬車卻動不了？�

entries.source:
COFFIN
#
TAFKTE
PREFEL
IOISFS
CHSEIN
#
The one who made it,
didn't want it.
The one who bought it,
didn't need it.
The one who used it,
never saw it.�
entries.translation:
COFFIN
#
TAFKTE
PREFEL
IOISFS
CHSEIN
#
製作它的人，
並不想要它。
買下它的人，
並不需要它。
使用它的人，
卻從未看過它。�

entries.source:
COLTS
#
BILET
TLABN
CRONE
SOTTS
#
What has a mare,
That the cow has not?�
entries.translation:
COLTS
#
BILET
TLABN
CRONE
SOTTS
#
母馬有什麼，
是母牛所沒有的？�

entries.source:
OUTSIDE
#
TREGCDS
PLTORWD
OHISINY
CUSTEAE
#
This side of a wolfhound
has the most hair.�
entries.translation:
OUTSIDE
#
TREGCDS
PLTORWD
OHISINY
CUSTEAE
#
獵狼犬的這一側，
毛髮最為濃密。�

entries.source:
CANDLE
#
TAEDIE
CHNSRT
ILOULD
BRTHES
#
Its orange eye blinks.
The burning tears flow.
But what its sorrow is,
None may ever know.�
entries.translation:
CANDLE
#
TAEDIE
CHNSRT
ILOULD
BRTHES
#
它橙色的眼眸眨動著，
灼熱的淚水流淌而下。
但它究竟為何悲傷，
誰也無從得知。�

entries.source:
BARROW
#
ETRIOS
RSWLNW
OAOHDG
BUTRTE
#
Two legs it has,
And this will confound:
Only at rest,
Do they touch the ground.�
entries.translation:
BARROW
#
ETRIOS
RSWLNW
OAOHDG
BUTRTE
#
它有兩條腿，
而這令人費解：
唯有靜止不動時，
它們才會碰到地面。�

entries.source:
ONION
#
KIIEN
OEVFE
SHROP
TNELS
#
She has tasteful friends
And tasteless enemies.
Tears are often shed on her behalf,
Yet never has she broken a heart.�
entries.translation:
ONION
#
KIIEN
OEVFE
SHROP
TNELS
#
她有識趣的朋友，
也有乏味的敵人。
人們常為她流淚，
但她從未讓誰心碎。�

entries.source:
SPIDER
#
TRLDRY
CHATEE
APSEOR
SEISTS
#
In all the world, none can compare,
To this tiny weaver, his deadly cloth
So silky and fair.�
entries.translation:
SPIDER
#
TRLDRY
CHATEE
APSEOR
SEISTS
#
在這世上，無人能及，
這位嬌小的織工，他致命的織物
是如此絲滑又美麗。�

entries.source:
BREATH
#
THTHCS
PISRFE
BLEANH
AROLTG
#
You can see it in winter,
never in summer.
Even though it is as light
as a feather, the mightiest moredhel
in the North can't hold it for long.�
entries.translation:
BREATH
#
THTHCS
PISRFE
BLEANH
AROLTG
#
你能在冬天看見它，
夏天卻看不到。
儘管它輕如
一根羽毛，就連北地最強大的莫瑞德人
也無法長久留住它。�

entries.source:
YESTERDAY
#
TOLIELIOE
YHORNRPTS
SETTHTDRY
PRSELETAD
#
Every creature in the world has seen it.
But to their dying day they'll never see
the same one again.�
entries.translation:
YESTERDAY
#
TOLIELIOE
YHORNRPTS
SETTHTDRY
PRSELETAD
#
世上每個生靈都見過它。
但直到他們死去的那天，也不會
再看到同一個了。�

entries.source:
BOTTLE
#
COEVLS
BRSIRD
FLTOWE
ASATOT
#
Kingdom soldiers will look like it,
When the headsman gives them a lop.
For then, like it, they'll have a neck,
But not a head on top.�
entries.translation:
BOTTLE
#
COEVLS
BRSIRD
FLTOWE
ASATOT
#
王國的士兵會變得像它一樣，
當劊子手手起刀落之後。
因為到那時，他們會跟它一樣有頸子，
頸子上頭卻沒有腦袋。�

entries.source:
GAUNTLET
#
SHUETSEC
ERRVEESE
GATNLLNT
CLNBMYOR
#
What is the thing
with fingers long,
That grips our deadly
swords so strong?�
entries.translation:
GAUNTLET
#
SHUETSEC
ERRVEESE
GATNLLNT
CLNBMYOR
#
什麼東西
有著長長的手指，
緊緊握住我們致命的
刀劍不放？�

entries.source:
HORSEMAN
#
WOTSOMEN
SERETNSP
HTHPSIAX
OCEIEUNW
#
Six legs, two heads,
two hands, one long nose.
Yet he uses only four legs
wherever he goes.�
entries.translation:
HORSEMAN
#
WOTSOMEN
SERETNSP
HTHPSIAX
OCEIEUNW
#
六條腿，兩個頭，
兩隻手，一個長鼻子。
但無論去哪裡，
他只用四條腿走路。�

entries.source:
COALS
#
THPLE
PRKSS
GOLTD
CEAOY
#
Black when bought.
Red when used.
Grey when thrown away.�
entries.translation:
COALS
#
THPLE
PRKSS
GOLTD
CEAOY
#
買來時是黑色的。
使用時是紅色的。
丟棄時是灰色的。�

entries.source:
SECRET
#
TEIRAE
SHOCLT
CLCEKS
ARLMEY
#
It is too much for one.
Two it is meant for.
But it no longer exists,
When the two become more.�
entries.translation:
SECRET
#
TEIRAE
SHOCLT
CLCEKS
ARLMEY
#
一個人擁有它太多，
它注定屬於兩個人。
但當兩人變成更多人時，
它便不復存在。�

entries.source:
FUTURE
#
BELUAE
FRIESD
SUSTET
PLTSRR
#
It never was before.
It is not now.
Fools wait for it forever.�
entries.translation:
FUTURE
#
BELUAE
FRIESD
SUSTET
PLTSRR
#
它從未存在於過去。
它此刻也不存在。
傻子卻永遠等著它。�

entries.source:
THOUGHT
#
PHENGSS
SRPBSHE
ASLUIOD
TEOVTLT
#
What ranges far and
cannot be confined,
yet stays in one spot?
The correct one will
open this chest.�
entries.translation:
THOUGHT
#
PHENGSS
SRPBSHE
ASLUIOD
TEOVTLT
#
什麼東西能遨遊四方、
無法被囚禁，
卻又停留在原地？
正確的答案
將能打開這個箱子。�

entries.source:
PADDLE
#
TASDOY
PHOSLS
CREREK
GIDLCE
#
Held firmly in the hands,
Like a sword it cuts deep.
Bloodless strokes, all,
Then forward we leap.�
entries.translation:
PADDLE
#
TASDOY
PHOSLS
CREREK
GIDLCE
#
緊緊握在手中，
如劍一般深深切入。
每一擊都不見血，
我們便向前躍去。�

entries.source:
SNAIL
#
KOSPL
ONETS
SHAYT
TELIR
#
Bloodless and boneless
it travels about.
Yet it never leaves home.�
entries.translation:
SNAIL
#
KOSPL
ONETS
SHAYT
TELIR
#
沒有血、沒有骨，
它四處遊走，
卻從未離開過家。�

entries.source:
BELL
#
SLCK
BIWS
RETL
ARLE
#
You hear it speak,
For it has a hard tongue.
But it cannot breathe,
For it has not a lung.�
entries.translation:
BELL
#
SLCK
BIWS
RETL
ARLE
#
你能聽見它說話，
因為它有一根堅硬的舌頭。
但它無法呼吸，
因為它沒有肺。�

entries.source:
SHOE
#
CHLT
SLOS
TEPE
AIAY
#
Has a tongue,
But never talks.
Has no legs,
But sometimes walks.�
entries.translation:
SHOE
#
CHLT
SLOS
TEPE
AIAY
#
它有舌頭，
卻從不說話。
它沒有腿，
卻有時會走路。�

entries.source:
STOVE
#
CHSVD
WTLOE
SLISS
OEOET
#
You seek it out,
When your hunger's ripe.
It sits on four legs,
And smokes a pipe.�
entries.translation:
STOVE
#
CHSVD
WTLOE
SLISS
OEOET
#
你會去尋找它，
當飢餓感正濃時。
它靠四條腿站立，
還叼著一根煙管。�

entries.source:
MATTRESS
#
BLTERIST
MEIRTEEY
CRETSPLD
AASSEDDS
#
Has feathers
but can't fly.
Rests on legs
but can't walk.�
entries.translation:
MATTRESS
#
BLTERIST
MEIRTEEY
CRETSPLD
AASSEDDS
#
它有羽毛，
卻不會飛。
靠著腿支撐，
卻不會走路。�

entries.source:
SQUARE
#
CQATRL
PHTADK
SAUDOE
AEIEPR
#
One pace to the North.
Two paces to the East.
Two paces to the South.
Two paces to the West.
One pace to the North.�
entries.translation:
SQUARE
#
CQATRL
PHTADK
SAUDOE
AEIEPR
#
向北走一步。
向東走兩步。
向南走兩步。
向西走兩步。
再向北走一步。�

entries.source:
SNOWFLAKE
#
TNFIFDRKY
WHRWLEAST
OREUISCEE
SEOBTLEOD
#
It flies without wings,
Drops without fear,
But held in warm hands,
It will soon disappear.�
entries.translation:
SNOWFLAKE
#
TNFIFDRKY
WHRWLEAST
OREUISCEE
SEOBTLEOD
#
它沒有翅膀卻能飛翔，
毫無畏懼地落下，
但只要握在溫暖的手中，
它很快就會消失無蹤。�

entries.source:
FLEAS
#
BLUER
ARERT
CETAD
FIOTS
#
When they are caught,
They are thrown away.
When they escape,
You itch all day.�
entries.translation:
FLEAS
#
BLUER
ARERT
CETAD
FIOTS
#
當牠們被抓住時，
就會被扔掉。
當牠們逃脫時，
你就會癢上一整天。�

entries.source:
THISTLE
#
CESSHDN
WRITTOL
OHAESPE
TILVILP
#
He stands beside the road in a
purple cap and tattered green cloak.
Those who touch him, curse him.�
entries.translation:
THISTLE
#
CESSHDN
WRITTOL
OHAESPE
TILVILP
#
他站在路邊，戴著
紫色的帽子，披著破爛的綠斗篷。
碰到他的人，都會咒罵他。�

entries.source:
BROOM
#
FSAOT
BIETM
ARRSH
GLORE
#
All about the house,
With his Lady he dances.
Yet he always works,
And never romances.�
entries.translation:
BROOM
#
FSAOT
BIETM
ARRSH
GLORE
#
在屋裡各處，
他與他的女主人共舞。
但他總是在工作，
從不談情說愛。�

entries.source:
PATH
#
CICH
PLTY
FROM
GALL
#
All across the countryside,
to front doors he travels.
But you never invite him in.�
entries.translation:
PATH
#
CICH
PLTY
FROM
GALL
#
走遍鄉間各處，
一路來到你的家門口。
但你從不曾邀他入內。�

entries.source:
KEY
#
TOB
HRT
EEY
KNI
#
Axes and swords,
Will not help you through.
Yet it and a little push will do.
Some in the road would
have fought and soon died,
Were it not close at hand,
to let them inside.�
entries.translation:
KEY
#
TOB
HRT
EEY
KNI
#
斧頭與長劍，
都幫不了你通過。
但它加上輕輕一推就能辦到。
路上有些人
原本會戰鬥，很快便會喪命，
若不是它就在手邊，
讓他們得以進門。�

entries.source:
SURF
#
AUOD
WRIF
MTVT
SARY
#
Pounds all day,
Beats all night,
Never rests.�
entries.translation:
SURF
#
AUOD
WRIF
MTVT
SARY
#
日日拍打，
夜夜擊打，
從不歇息。�

entries.source:
WATERFALL
#
TRYOEUCIE
OHTRONBOL
CAIHRAATS
WEDEMFELT
#
This old one runs forever,
But never moves at all.
He has not lungs, nor throat,
Still, a mighty roaring call.�
entries.translation:
WATERFALL
#
TRYOEUCIE
OHTRONBOL
CAIHRAATS
WEDEMFELT
#
這位老者永遠奔流不止，
卻絲毫不曾移動半分。
他沒有肺，也沒有喉嚨，
卻仍有著震天的怒吼。�

entries.source:
DICE
#
BIEE
ALCK
DUOH
OSLY
#
You can count on them, though
some would rather curse
them. You can speak dear to them,
though well all know 'tis
just in vain.�
entries.translation:
DICE
#
BIEE
ALCK
DUOH
OSLY
#
你可以信賴它們，儘管
有些人寧願咒罵
它們。你也能對它們說盡好話，
儘管大家都心知肚明，
那不過是徒勞。�

entries.source:
LOGS
#
TIAD
LRSE
IOTG
DMGS
#
They have not lips nor tongues,
Yet lead them green to the pit,
And as they die you will hear,
Them sputter, hiss and spit.�
entries.translation:
LOGS
#
TIAD
LRSE
IOTG
DMGS
#
它們沒有嘴唇，也沒有舌頭，
但把新砍的它們送進坑裡，
當它們死去時你會聽見，
劈啪、嘶嘶又噴濺。�

entries.source:
FARRIER
#
BRIROED
FALTLAR
ALSOTLS
CERSIFE
#
There is a shoemaker in the dell.
Makes his shoes with steel and nail.
Although his goods last right well,
Folks need two pair, without fail.�
entries.translation:
FARRIER
#
BRIROED
FALTLAR
ALSOTLS
CERSIFE
#
山谷裡住著一位鞋匠。
用鋼鐵與釘子製鞋。
雖然他的貨色十分耐用，
大家還是少不了要買兩雙。�

entries.source:
BRIDGE
#
THEDTS
CRINEE
BOSAGL
WANHSY
#
When it is stout,
People gladly tread.
When it is thin,
People walk in dread.�
entries.translation:
BRIDGE
#
THEDTS
CRINEE
BOSAGL
WANHSY
#
當它堅固時，
人們樂意踏上。
當它單薄時，
人們心懷恐懼地行走。�

entries.source:
MIRROR
#
VAEOST
MEREOE
LISRUS
HOTTNR
#
Look in my face,
I am somebody.
Look at my back,
I am nobody.�
entries.translation:
MIRROR
#
VAEOST
MEREOE
LISRUS
HOTTNR
#
看著我的正面，
我是某個人。
看看我的背面，
我誰也不是。�

entries.source:
SNARES
#
BRATLY
SKOLSD
TEIRES
ANBATT
#
The bones of the dead,
Can be used to trap the living.�
entries.translation:
SNARES
#
BRATLY
SKOLSD
TEIRES
ANBATT
#
死者的骨頭，
能用來捕捉活物。�

entries.source:
TROLLS
#
TOTELC
BROSDV
CHALSA
WLPIYS
#
Say away fom these hideus
beasts, they kil our females
and chidrens.�
entries.translation:
TROLLS
#
TOTELC
BROSDV
CHALSA
WLPIYS
#
離這些醜陋的
野獸遠一點，牠們殺我們的女人
和小孩。�

entries.source:
BOOK
#
TORA
BRTK
CLOS
SAST
#
It is a journey whose path
depends, on another's vision
of where it ends.�
entries.translation:
BOOK
#
TORA
BRTK
CLOS
SAST
#
這是一段旅程，它的路徑
取決於另一個人的想像，
想像它會通向何方。�

entries.source:
BLADE
#
BRINK
FOALM
ANFIE
KLNDG
#
Blessed are the first.
Slow are the second.
Playful are the third.
Bold are the fourth.
Brave are the fifth.�
entries.translation:
BLADE
#
BRINK
FOALM
ANFIE
KLNDG
#
第一個是受祝福的。
第二個是遲緩的。
第三個是愛玩的。
第四個是大膽的。
第五個是勇敢的。�

entries.source:
ASHES
#
SLOOY
AHTED
CSSWS
TEHST
#
After the final fire,
the winds will blow.
And these, which are already dead,
will cover the ones who have
yet to die.�
entries.translation:
ASHES
#
SLOOY
AHTED
CSSWS
TEHST
#
最後一把火燒盡之後，
風將會吹起。
而這些早已死去的東西，
將會覆蓋那些
尚未死去的人。�

entries.source:
ORANGE
#
THAORT
CRNDDE
OAINSY
PMSCGS
#
Men seize it from its home,
tear apart its flesh,
drink the sweet blood,
then cast its skin aside.�
entries.translation:
ORANGE
#
THAORT
CRNDDE
OAINSY
PMSCGS
#
人們把它從家鄉奪走，
撕開它的果肉，
啜飲它甜美的汁液，
再將果皮丟到一旁。�

entries.source:
ICICLE
#
LEIELT
IRTRHL
GCOHTE
CACCES
#
You see me oft,
In woods and town.
With my roots above,
I must grow down.�
entries.translation:
ICICLE
#
LEIELT
IRTRHL
GCOHTE
CACCES
#
你常常看見我，
在林間，也在城裡。
我的根長在上頭，
我卻只能向下生長。�

entries.source:
GRAVE
#
SELET
GHTTS
DREVR
ALAAE
#
A strange earthen house,
That brings nought but disdain.
And yet those who stay there,
Never do complain.�
entries.translation:
GRAVE
#
SELET
GHTTS
DREVR
ALAAE
#
一間奇怪的土屋，
帶來的只有輕蔑。
然而住在裡頭的人，
卻從不曾抱怨。�

entries.source:
EYES
#
SARD
TLES
EHTY
CYOB
#
Twins on either side of
a ridge that smells.
They shall never see
each other directly.�
entries.translation:
EYES
#
SARD
TLES
EHTY
CYOB
#
一對雙生子分居
一道會聞味道的山脊兩側。
它們永遠
無法直視彼此。�

entries.source:
RAIN
#
RIAC
HRLN
OOTV
DAIG
#
With flashing sword and booming cry,
With darkness staining land and sky,
The army comes, prepared to die.
Soldiers fall in glistening dress,
As battles are joined without egress,
Save comfort in the earth's caress.�
entries.translation:
RAIN
#
RIAC
HRLN
OOTV
DAIG
#
隨著劍光閃爍、呼喊震天，
隨著黑暗染污了大地與天空，
大軍到來，早已抱定必死的決心。
士兵們穿著閃亮的軍裝倒下，
戰鬥一旦開打便無路可退，
唯有大地的懷抱能給予慰藉。�

entries.source:
STARS
#
SARDS
TLASL
EHTYM
CTORA
#
The wheel is steered,
Despite the night.
They prefer our lead,
More than the light.�
entries.translation:
STARS
#
SARDS
TLASL
EHTYM
CTORA
#
縱使身處黑夜，
舵輪依然能被掌控。
比起光亮，
它們更偏愛我們的引路。�

entries.source:
SADDLE
#
THDELY
CAEDRS
ORBWSE
STVIEL
#
When it is down,
It is lower than a horse's belly.
When it is up,
It is higher than a horse's back.�
entries.translation:
SADDLE
#
THDELY
CAEDRS
ORBWSE
STVIEL
#
當它放下時，
比馬的肚子還低。
當它抬起時，
比馬的背還高。�

entries.source:
SPONGE
#
CPTEGY
RRNSTD
SHITSS
IEONEE
#
Holes at the top.
Holes at the bottom.
Holes in the middle.
But still it holds water.�
entries.translation:
SPONGE
#
CPTEGY
RRNSTD
SHITSS
IEONEE
#
頂端有孔洞。
底部也有孔洞。
中間還是孔洞。
但它依然能盛住水。�

entries.source:
BRIARS
#
THIURS
CLETDT
ORSASE
BEAROH
#
Claws like a cat,
Crooked as a snake's hiss.
Patch together your guesses,
You won't guess this.�
entries.translation:
BRIARS
#
THIURS
CLETDT
ORSASE
BEAROH
#
爪子像貓，
彎曲得像蛇的嘶聲。
就算拼湊你所有的猜測，
你也猜不出這是什麼。�

entries.source:
SIEVE
#
BREEL
SHAVE
ALLST
WIOLD
#
Round as an apple,
Deep as a cup,
All the Bitter Sea,
Can't fill it up.�
entries.translation:
SIEVE
#
BREEL
SHAVE
ALLST
WIOLD
#
圓得像顆蘋果，
深得像個杯子，
就算是整片苦海，
也填不滿它。�

entries.source:
DRUM
#
TRAK
BIUP
DLCM
EOTH
#
Although my cow is dead,
I continue to beat her.
What a racket she makes!�
entries.translation:
DRUM
#
TRAK
BIUP
DLCM
EOTH
#
雖然我的牛已經死了，
我仍然不斷地打她。
她發出的聲響可真吵啊！�

entries.source:
BUTTON
#
CUOHHD
BLITRY
PRSPES
GETEON
#
Flat as a leaf,
Round as a ring,
Has two eyes,
But can't see a thing.�
entries.translation:
BUTTON
#
CUOHHD
BLITRY
PRSPES
GETEON
#
扁得像片葉子，
圓得像個戒指，
有兩隻眼睛，
卻什麼也看不見。�

entries.source:
TRADE MARES
#
RWRDL ATJSN
OENCE TOKOT
TLIPC MNFEV
SRANK UARHS
#
Two brothers wanted to race a course,
To see which had the slowest horse.
Since neither wanted to spur his mare,
What must they do to make it fair?�
entries.translation:
TRADE MARES
#
RWRDL ATJSN
OENCE TOKOT
TLIPC MNFEV
SRANK UARHS
#
兩兄弟想比賽一段路程，
看誰的母馬跑得比較慢。
既然誰也不想催促自己的馬，
他們該怎麼做才公平？�

entries.source:
WALNUT
#
SAETES
CTRLUT
WHLORD
ARSNSY
#
A box beneath a tree,
Inside some tasty meat.
Kept for a month or more,
It still tastes just as sweet.�
entries.translation:
WALNUT
#
SAETES
CTRLUT
WHLORD
ARSNSY
#
樹下有一個盒子，
裡頭裝著美味的果肉。
就算存放一個月以上，
嚐起來依然一樣香甜。�

entries.source:
PIPE
#
OHDE
PLER
SRPD
CIST
#
Its tail is round and hollow,
Seems to get chewed a bit,
But you'll rarely see this thing,
Unless the other end is lit.�
entries.translation:
PIPE
#
OHDE
PLER
SRPD
CIST
#
它的尾端又圓又中空，
看起來像被咬過幾口，
但你很少會見到這東西，
除非另一端已經點燃。�

entries.source:
DOOR
#
BOTN
DRSE
ELOL
FSAR
#
It doesn't live within a house,
Nor does it live without.
Most will use it when they come in,
And again when they go out.�
entries.translation:
DOOR
#
BOTN
DRSE
ELOL
FSAR
#
它不住在屋子裡面，
也不住在屋子外面。
大多數人進門時會用它，
出門時也會再用一次。�

entries.source:
STAKE
#
TEFBT
SAAMS
IHOKY
RTLEE
#
Although lower than a fence,
And thinner than a rail,
It can still be used to hold a horse;
Hooves, mane and tail.�
entries.translation:
STAKE
#
TEFBT
SAAMS
IHOKY
RTLEE
#
雖然比籬笆矮，
也比欄杆細，
它依然能拴住一匹馬；
蹄、鬃毛與尾巴。�

entries.source:
BOOK
#
CONS
BLEE
GRSK
IEOT
#
Though not a plant, has leaves.
Though not a beast, has spine.
Though many wouldn't need this thing,
'Tis more valuable than wine.�
entries.translation:
BOOK
#
CONS
BLEE
GRSK
IEOT
#
雖非植物，卻有葉子。
雖非野獸，卻有脊梁。
雖然許多人用不到它，
它卻比美酒更加珍貴。�

entries.source:
PLOW
#
CLIW
PHAT
SEOP
TRSY
#
Four legs in front, two behind.
Its steely armor scratched and
dented by rocks and sticks.
Still it toils as it helps feed
the hungry.�
entries.translation:
PLOW
#
CLIW
PHAT
SEOP
TRSY
#
前頭四條腿，後頭兩條腿。
它的鋼鐵鎧甲被岩石與樹枝
刮傷、磕出凹痕。
它仍然辛勤勞作，
為飢餓的人們提供食糧。�

entries.source:
BULL
#
BATI
TELS
CREL
OUST
#
In the fields a frightful thing,
Watch it and you will find,
It has a pitchfork in the front,
And a broom back behind.�
entries.translation:
BULL
#
BATI
TELS
CREL
OUST
#
田野裡有個嚇人的東西，
仔細一瞧你會發現，
它前頭有把乾草叉，
後頭還拖著一把掃帚。�

entries.source:
PROMISE
#
JARMLAY
PLSITTE
BRASWSS
CEOTIET
#
Our valiant leaders will keep this.
But only after they have given it.�
entries.translation:
PROMISE
#
JARMLAY
PLSITTE
BRASWSS
CEOTIET
#
我們英勇的首領會信守這個。
但唯有在他們許下之後。�

entries.source:
DEATH
#
THACK
DRTTE
RESHY
COUEH
#
What is this thing that having it,
You can no longer give it away,
But lacking it, for the moment at least,
You can give it to those who must pay?�
entries.translation:
DEATH
#
THACK
DRTTE
RESHY
COUEH
#
有一樣東西，一旦你擁有了它，
就再也無法把它送出去，
但若你還沒擁有它，至少此刻，
你能把它送給那些欠債之人？�

entries.source:
DISPUTE
#
DSWPSTY
HISOILE
LTOHUER
EAISRID
#
Whoever has it is angry,
Whoever loses it is angrier,
Whoever wins it has it no more.�
entries.translation:
DISPUTE
#
DSWPSTY
HISOILE
LTOHUER
EAISRID
#
擁有它的人生氣，
失去它的人更生氣，
贏得它的人卻不再擁有它。�

entries.source:
MUSIC
#
RTHIC
NSSST
MOILO
AUTDY
#
This wondrous thing, though not
an herb, can help comfort the weak
and the dying. It can even be used to
rally the troops, or make one start
laughing or crying.�
entries.translation:
MUSIC
#
RTHIC
NSSST
MOILO
AUTDY
#
這神奇的東西，雖然不是
藥草，卻能安慰虛弱
與垂死之人。它甚至能用來
鼓舞軍心，或是讓人
又哭又笑。�

entries.source:
BUBBLE
#
FOBPLY
PLDSHE
BRINOS
EUABIT
#
This sparkling globe
can float on water,
and weighs not more
than a feather.
Yet despite its weight ten
giants could
never pick it up.�
entries.translation:
BUBBLE
#
FOBPLY
PLDSHE
BRINOS
EUABIT
#
這顆閃閃發亮的圓球
能浮在水面上，
重量不會超過
一根羽毛。
然而儘管如此輕盈，十個
巨人
也永遠拿不起它。�

entries.source:
ROPE
#
MBTN
RVSE
OOES
PEPT
#
Ten troll's strength,
Ten troll's length,
One troll can pick it up,
No troll can stand it up.�
entries.translation:
ROPE
#
MBTN
RVSE
OOES
PEPT
#
十個巨魔的力氣，
十個巨魔的長度，
一個巨魔就能舉起它，
卻沒有一個巨魔能讓它站起來。�

entries.source:
OCEAN
#
CCASE
OIEON
TRBAL
PHCLS
#
A shimmering field that reaches far.
Yet it has no tracks,
And is crossed without paths.�
entries.translation:
OCEAN
#
CCASE
OIEON
TRBAL
PHCLS
#
一片閃爍的原野延伸至遠方。
它卻沒有軌跡，
橫越它也不需要道路。�

entries.source:
SHOES
#
BDREY
SLOSL
HOSLT
AHEIS
#
You tie these things,
Before you go.
And untie them,
After you stop.�
entries.translation:
SHOES
#
BDREY
SLOSL
HOSLT
AHEIS
#
出發之前，
你會繫緊這東西。
停下之後，
你又會把它解開。�

entries.source:
DARKNESS
#
TATHEENW
GRETANYB
DUSKHLSZ
AIRENOTS
#
This engulfing thing,
is strange indeed.
The greater it grows,
the less you see.�
entries.translation:
DARKNESS
#
TATHEENW
GRETANYB
DUSKHLSZ
AIRENOTS
#
這吞噬一切的東西，
確實十分古怪。
它越是壯大，
你看見的就越少。�

entries.source:
LIFE
#
PSTE
HEFS
AIED
LTDT
#
Don't grow too attached to this thing.
Without it you will never even know it
is gone. But be careful friend, it is
much easier to lose on Kingdom soil.�
entries.translation:
LIFE
#
PSTE
HEFS
AIED
LTDT
#
別對這東西太過依戀。
少了它，你甚至永遠不會知道
它已經消失。但小心了朋友，它
在王國的土地上更容易失去。�

entries.source:
EQUALS
#
SHTABY
TINBSL
WQATLD
ESUEES
#
What is it of yours that you
see every day, but our Leader
sees only rarely?�
entries.translation:
EQUALS
#
SHTABY
TINBSL
WQATLD
ESUEES
#
你有什麼東西，
你每天都看得到，但我們的首領
卻極少看見？�

entries.source:
GLAMREDHEL
#
RCONCADGSR
MMAHOOONEY
ATRMGNTARN
SANDIBURDS
GEIORIRQUT
ILUVASHELL
CIESDELAAE
KRSPMUBHBD
#
Where once there were three,
Now only are two,
Ancient kin ours,
Whom we sent to their doom.�
entries.translation:
GLAMREDHEL
#
RCONCADGSR
MMAHOOONEY
ATRMGNTARN
SANDIBURDS
GEIORIRQUT
ILUVASHELL
CIESDELAAE
KRSPMUBHBD
#
曾經有三位，
如今只剩兩位，
是我們古老的親族，
是我們親手送往末路的族人。�

entries.source:
JACKET
#
MAOHLL
JLEKST
EIRLES
KOCIOD
#
Neck, but no head.
Arms, but no hands.
Waist, but no legs.�
entries.translation:
JACKET
#
MAOHLL
JLEKST
EIRLES
KOCIOD
#
有頸子，卻沒有頭。
有手臂，卻沒有手。
有腰身，卻沒有腿。�

entries.source:
SAWDUST
#
CEORLIY
THNDUES
ALWQRLT
SATOESE
#
A carpenter left some wood,
Would not take it back.
I saw some dust where he left it,
But couldn't find his stack.�
entries.translation:
SAWDUST
#
CEORLIY
THNDUES
ALWQRLT
SATOESE
#
一位木匠留下了些木材，
卻不肯收回去。
我在他留下的地方看到了木屑，
卻找不到他那堆木材。�

entries.source:
NOOSE
#
TOSES
RSODE
NLLSW
EATOD
#
Once alive, but now twisted 'round.
It is used by moredhel and men to
punish their own kind.�
entries.translation:
NOOSE
#
TOSES
RSODE
NLLSW
EATOD
#
曾經是活的，如今卻被扭成一圈。
莫瑞德人與人類都用它，
來懲罰自己的同類。�

entries.source:
EGGS
#
TOGY
ETET
LSID
AGTS
#
No visible flesh,
Nor blood, nor bone,
But given time,
They will walk alone.�
entries.translation:
EGGS
#
TOGY
ETET
LSID
AGTS
#
看不見血肉，
沒有血，也沒有骨頭，
但假以時日，
它們就能自己行走。�

entries.source:
FIRE
#
BRRD
GLFS
FIAT
ASEE
#
Put into a pit.
Locked behind a steel grate.
Guarded all through the night,
still it goes out.�
entries.translation:
FIRE
#
BRRD
GLFS
FIAT
ASEE
#
被丟進坑裡。
被鎖在鋼柵欄後頭。
整夜都有人看守，
它仍然會熄滅。�

entries.source:
ECHO
#
TCKD
EHHO
CLOS

#
Answers its caller without being
asked. Responds within seconds, and
speaks all languages with equal ease.�
entries.translation:
ECHO
#
TCKD
EHHO
CLOS
SAWT
#
不待呼喚，就會回應
呼喚它的人。幾秒之內便有回音，
而且能輕鬆說出所有語言。�

entries.source:
ALPHABET
#
WRSHTDEE
TLATOIAS
ASEPMBST
BEPOANTY
#
This marvelous thing,
Though it sounds absurd,
Contains all our letters,
But is only a word.�
entries.translation:
ALPHABET
#
WRSHTDEE
TLATOIAS
ASEPMBST
BEPOANTY
#
這神奇的東西，
雖然聽起來很荒謬，
包含了我們所有的字母，
本身卻只是一個詞。�

entries.source:
PRIEST
#
BRLESD
PLELHT
DEITOS
AOPSUY
#
This Kingdom fool has married
many women. Yet he has never
been married.�
entries.translation:
PRIEST
#
BRLESD
PLELHT
DEITOS
AOPSUY
#
這位王國的傻子已經主持過
許多樁婚禮。然而他自己
卻從未結過婚。�

entries.source:
TOWEL
#
HLALY
TEWAT
ROSED
EDRSL
#
This odd thing seems to get wetter,
The more it dries.�
entries.translation:
TOWEL
#
HLALY
TEWAT
ROSED
EDRSL
#
這古怪的東西似乎越擦
就變得越濕。�

entries.source:
CANE
#
TATE
CHND
BLIL
ORPS
#
Though blind as well,
Can lead the blind well.�
entries.translation:
CANE
#
TATE
CHND
BLIL
ORPS
#
雖然它自己也看不見，
卻能領著盲人好好走路。�

entries.source:
MOUSER
#
QISSHD
KLATAS
MUEHTR
EOUAEY
#
What goes down to the cellar
with four legs,
but comes back with eight?�
entries.translation:
MOUSER
#
QISSHD
KLATAS
MUEHTR
EOUAEY
#
什麼東西用四條腿
走進地窖，
出來時卻有八條腿？�

entries.source:
TEMPER
#
CLAPVT
TRMSEE
SHERLD
OEPASR
#
You must keep this thing.
Its loss will affect your brothers,
For once yours is lost,
It will soon be lost by others.�
entries.translation:
TEMPER
#
CLAPVT
TRMSEE
SHERLD
OEPASR
#
你必須守住這東西。
失去它會牽連你的兄弟，
因為一旦你失去了它，
別人很快也會跟著失去。�

entries.source:
HONEY
#
RSMST
LANNS
HEAED
IOPAY
#
Though a tasty treat,
Made in spiral towers,
Rarely will it be eaten alone.�
entries.translation:
HONEY
#
RSMST
LANNS
HEAED
IOPAY
#
雖然是道美味佳餚，
產自螺旋狀的塔樓，
卻很少單獨被享用。�

entries.source:
WATER
#
PLESR
WRTED
SHALT
CAOAY
#
This great thing can be swallowed,
But can also swallow us.�
entries.translation:
WATER
#
PLESR
WRTED
SHALT
CAOAY
#
這偉大的東西能被吞下，
但它也能將我們吞沒。�

entries.source:
HASTE
#
ROSET
LSLSS
AAORD
HITTE
#
Inside a burning house,
This thing is best to make.
And best to make it quickly before,
The fire's too much to take.�
entries.translation:
HASTE
#
ROSET
LSLSS
AAORD
HITTE
#
在燃燒的屋子裡，
最該做的就是這件事。
而且最好趁早動手，
免得烈焰再也無法忍受。�

entries.source:
WEARY
#
TIAPY
CRIRT
WHOEN
OERSR
#
Plow and hoe, reap and sow,
What soon does every farmer grow?�
entries.translation:
WEARY
#
TIAPY
CRIRT
WHOEN
OERSR
#
犁田鋤地，播種收割，
每個農夫很快就會長出什麼？�

entries.source:
ADVICE
#
PIESCS
AHOIED
CDVCHE
TRAATY
#
Everyone offers this thing.
But few will take it when it
is offered by someone else.�
entries.translation:
ADVICE
#
PIESCS
AHOIED
CDVCHE
TRAATY
#
人人都樂於給予這東西。
但當它是由別人給出時，
卻很少有人願意接受。�

entries.source:
STRANGER
#
COSAEFIE
SRISPALT
PTETNEED
AHRDRGSR
#
You will invite him into your house,
Yet you know him not.
Once you get to know him,
This thing he will no longer be.�
entries.translation:
STRANGER
#
COSAEFIE
SRISPALT
PTETNEED
AHRDRGSR
#
你會邀請他進到你家，
卻對他一無所知。
一旦你了解了他，
他就不再是這個東西了。�

entries.source:
LAKE
#
HSKO
LOLJ
MAOL
EISE
#
I saw him where he never was,
And where he could not be.
And yet within this place,
I saw a wavering face,
Staring back at me.�
entries.translation:
LAKE
#
HSKO
LOLJ
MAOL
EISE
#
我在他從未待過、
也不可能存在的地方看見了他。
然而就在這個地方，
我看見一張晃動的臉，
正回望著我。�

entries.source:
SPURS
#
CRETY
SHUSD
PPAES
AIYRT
#
We travel much, yet prisoners are,
And close confined, to boot.
Yet with any horse we will keep pace,
And always go on foot.�
entries.translation:
SPURS
#
CRETY
SHUSD
PPAES
AIYRT
#
我們四處旅行，卻也是囚徒，
而且被緊緊拘束在靴子上。
然而無論什麼馬，我們都跟得上，
卻永遠只能靠步行。�

entries.source:
GALLOWS
#
EHEPETS
GRASCET
CLLEBWD
SAOLONY
#
When people come for me to meet,
They come to me with heavy feet.
The one I hold,
When I get my chance,
Will turn and spin,
And start to dance.�
entries.translation:
GALLOWS
#
EHEPETS
GRASCET
CLLEBWD
SAOLONY
#
當人們前來與我相見，
他們的腳步總是沉重。
我所擁抱的那個人，
一旦輪到我出手，
便會旋轉、打轉，
跳起舞來。�

entries.source:
FOG
#
EOE
GRA
FLL
SAG
#
When it comes in,
From sea to shore,
Twenty paces you'll see,
No less, no more.�
entries.translation:
FOG
#
EOE
GRA
FLL
SAG
#
當它湧來時，
從海面直到岸邊，
你能看見的只有二十步遠，
不多也不少。�

entries.source:
BARK
#
EOEN
GRAM
BLLK
SARB
#
Like dogs shouting at the moon,
Or armor worn by the trees.
Like a sharply spoken command,
Or a tiny vessel upon the seas.�

像狗對著月亮吠叫，

像是一聲嚴厲的口令，
又或是海上一艘小小的船。�
